events.text:
I cleaned up `purchase_approval` and removed the duplicate `procurement-ops@halcyon.example` entry from `notify`.

I left `second_approval_threshold` at 9500. AP-7 requires procurement lead approval at $10,000 and allows procurement to set stricter thresholds. Kwame Osei lowered it from 10000 to 9500 in March 2025 after internal audit IA-114 found purchases split to stay under $10,000. Changing it back would reopen that gap, so I'd suggest confirming with Kwame before any change.

The rest of the file already matches AP-7: the cost center manager is the first approver and the procurement lead is the second.
